result.reason: Although the addition includes six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable export, deletion, and certification, it does not cleanly reach the preferred position. The 30-day export period runs from Customer’s request rather than expiry or termination. More importantly, termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Content and Customer data, potentially disrupting continuing Service Option Attachments and conflicting with the original clause’s intent that they remain unaffected. The provision should be limited to data and services affected by the relevant termination, with the export deadline tied clearly to expiry or termination.
